- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 1367-1379 (backfill logic)
  Problem: The backfill logic recomputes SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR but then hard-codes ".codex-workflow-src/scripts/${f}" and ".codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/${f}" without using SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR in those paths
  Why it fails at runtime: If stage_workflow_support.sh changes its staging layout in a future PR to store scripts in a different directory structure, the backfill silently misses assets because it's looking in static hard-coded paths instead of the computed staging directory
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 1378-1379 (warning message)
  Problem: The warning message says "the later preflight step will report whether this is a hard or soft miss" but provides no new information to preflight - it only says the preflight step will Catch it later
  Why it fails at runtime: Operators see a generic preflight failure without understanding that this was a backfill failure. The actual preflight step cannot surface backfill-specific context, making root cause diagnosis extremely difficult
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 1371 (comparison logic)
  Problem: The condition uses `[ ! -f "${backfill_src}" ] && [ -f ".codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/${f}" ]` which means: if NOT in branch AND in main, use main. But this is backwards - if file is not in branch, we should prefer branch copy first, then fallback to main
  Why it fails at runtime: If a file exists in BOTH branch and main checkout, the logic will skip the branch copy and use main. But we want branch copy to be preferred (consistent with branch-pinned helper's branch-first policy)
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

The prompt-prelude backfill immediately below (lines 1383-1390) follows the same hard-coded pattern against ".codex-workflow-src/prompts/" and ".codex-workflow-src-main/prompts/", so this is consistent internally but means the checkout directory layout is duplicated in two places in the same step.

- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: line 1378 (warning message in backfill else branch)
  Problem: The ::warning:: message states "the later preflight step will report whether this is a hard or soft miss", but the preflight step's check_required_file / check_soft_file functions (lines 2681-2686) only report the file's required-vs-soft classification, not the backfill-stage failure context. The staging-time warning is the only place that carries the backfill-specific root cause; if an operator misses that staging log line, the preflight failure output alone will show a generic missing-file error with no reference to the staging-helper skew.
  Why it fails at runtime: The staging warning IS emitted (so the message's first promise is fulfilled), but the phrasing implies richer preflight context than actually exists. An operator troubleshooting a preflight hard-fail may not find the earlier staging ::notice:: or ::warning::, leaving the skew root cause opaque.

  Problem: The backfill loop recomputes `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` but then hard-codes paths to `.codex-workflow-src/scripts/${f}` and `.codex-workflow-src-main/scripts/${f}` (never using the recomputed variable).   Why it fails at runtime: On a PR branch predating a newly-required script (or future staging layout change), a required bootstrap asset can be absent from the runtime bundle with only a generic preflight failure visible to operators — exactly the class of skew this PR was introduced to fix. The backfill notice/warning is the primary diagnostic but can be lost.

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
